headline: Cisco Is Deploying AI Agents to All 90,000 Employees. Here’s What the Economics Look Like.
summary: Cisco is not running a pilot program. Starting at the end of July 2026, the company is deploying a personalized AI agent to every single one of its 90,000 employees. This is a structural overhaul of how a Fortune 500 company operates, moving beyond the experimental phase into a full-scale integration of autonomous agents across […]

headline: AI is Hollowing Out Tech Sector Jobs: Oracle and Microsoft Help Push Layoff Rate to 20-Year High
summary: Tech giants are pouring hundreds of billions into AI while quietly gutting the workforces that built them, and the labor data reveals a layoff rate that dwarfs anything seen during the 2008 financial crisis or the dot-com bust.
